test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Name the campaign launched by the Madhya Pradesh government on the occasion of National Girl Child Day on January 24, 2021, under the 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' scheme.
solution:
The correct answer is __**PANKH Abhiyan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Pankh campaign,** launched on **National Girl Child Day** on January 24, 2021, is part of the "Beti Bachao Beti Padhao" Scheme administered by the Madhya Pradesh Government and spearheaded by Chief Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan.
 
• PANKH stands for Protection, Awareness of rights, Nutrition, Knowledge, and Health, encapsulating the key pillars essential for the holistic development of girls.
 
• This initiative is dedicated to fostering the overall growth and well-being of the girl child.
 
• Additionally, the Ladli Laxmi Yojana in Madhya Pradesh represents another noteworthy effort aimed at supporting the welfare of girls in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Manjhi Kanya Bhagyashree scheme **was introduced in 2015 by the Women and Child Development Department of Maharashtra. It aims to support the welfare and development of girls in the state.
 
• **Udaan** is a project initiated by the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) under the auspices of the Ministry of Human Resource Development, Government of India. 
 
• **The Balika Samriddhi Yojana** is a government program designed to promote the well-being of girls. It provides financial assistance after the birth of a girl child and upon completion of her education, with the objective of combating negative attitudes towards daughters.
